name: Daikuuji Kiki Ippatsu!
source:
"If" story with Ayu and Mayu from Kimi ga Nozomu Eien.
Main character works at a shop when walls start to be destructed by a strange bunch of people who want to create a new world. Protagonist falls in love with their leader Ayu from the first sight. He swears to protect her from whatever crazy enemies she might have.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《你所期望的永远》中亚由与真由的“如果”故事。

主人公在一家店里工作时，一群怪人开始毁坏墙壁，声称要创造新世界。主人公对她们的领袖亚由一见钟情，并发誓无论面对多么疯狂的敌人，都要保护她。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
